cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Hand me the drawer key before I sign the club accounts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. My signature covers the receipts too. Let me check how it adds up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If you find a mistake, my name goes on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put mine beside yours. Give me the key and we'll correct it together before either name goes outside this room.

mechanism: A uses signature authority and a promise of controlled shared responsibility to obtain the evidence key.
confusable: Unlike shifting blame, A offers to put A's name beside B's while insisting on inspection before approval.
comparison: Account receipts and joint correction differ from restricting access to one private line.
seedUse: The seed's signature gate, receipts demand and controlled correction already give S01 a practical role in the persuasion.
